not_findings: External-project children intentionally share one workspace and are serialized; worktree children can run concurrently.
A stopped child turn deliberately leaves its task running and its workspace entry held.
SESS-13 explicitly permits logging a save error while continuing; CORE-04 addresses lost dirty state after the error, not the continuation policy alone.
The last persistence interval may be lost on abrupt VM termination by explicit SESS-44 design.
Limits checked only between steps match LOOP-20/22; no hard in-flight deadline is currently promised.
